'''Vanderlan da Silva Bolzani''' (born November 19, 1949) is a Brazilian chemist at the [[São Paulo State University]]. She has previously served as president of the [[Brazilian Chemical Society]] and was awarded the 2011 [[American Chemical Society]] – [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry]] Distinguished Women in Science Chemistry and Chemical Engineering Award.

== Early life and education ==
Bolzani was born in Santa Rita and raised in [[João Pessoa, Paraíba]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/en/2014/08/23/vanderlan-da-silva-bolzani-chemistry-natural-products/|title=Vanderlan da Silva Bolzani: The chemistry of natural products {{!}} Revista Pesquisa Fapesp|website=revistapesquisa.fapesp.br|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref> Her grandmother was indigenous, and Bolzani recalls playing with [[natural pigment]]s from saffron in her grandmother's farm.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://cibfar.ifsc.usp.br/english/2019/03/22/brazilian-society-of-chemistry-sbq-creates-vanderlan-da-silva-bolzani-award/|title=Brazilian Society of Chemistry – SBQ creates Vanderlan da Silva Bolzani Award|website=CIBFar|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-07|archive-date=2019-10-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191007202114/http://cibfar.ifsc.usp.br/english/2019/03/22/brazilian-society-of-chemistry-sbq-creates-vanderlan-da-silva-bolzani-award/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Her parents were of [[Portuguese people|Portuguese]] and [[Tabajara]] heritage.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www2.unesp.br/portal#!/noticia/5559/pesquisadora-da-unesp-e-a-primeira-fellow-da-royal-society-of-chemistry-na-al/|title=Unesp - Universidade Estadual Paulista - Portal|website=www2.unesp.br|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref> As a child she studied the fishing colony on Formosa beach, and became interested in the natural world.<ref name=":0" /> In high school she specialised in science.<ref name=":0" /> She earned her undergraduate degree in pharmacy at the [[Federal University of Paraíba]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://www.ufrgs.br/brazmedchem2012/?secao=conf_vanderlan|title=BrazMedChem 2012|website=www.ufrgs.br|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref> During her undergraduate studies she became interested in organic and analytical chemistry.<ref name=":1" /> She moved to the [[São Paulo State University]] in 1975, where she specialised in [[organic chemistry]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://blogs.rsc.org/np/2011/11/18/new-advisory-board-members-for-npr/|title=New Advisory Board members for NPR – Natural Products Blog|last=Packers|first=Export|last2=says|first2=Movers|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref> She had originally planned to work with Paulo de Carvalho, but he died suddenly of a heart attack.<ref name=":0" /> Her supervisor, was [[Otto Gottlieb]]. She worked on [[Mikania|''Mikania hirsutissima'']] and earned her master's degree in 1977 and PhD in 1982.<ref name=":3" /> Her master's dissertation considered the ''[[Euphorbiaceae]]'' of the [[Amazon rainforest]].<ref name=":0" /> For her doctoral dissertation she concentrated on the theoretical aspects of botany, taxonomy and biology of the ''[[Rubiaceae]]''.<ref name=":0" /> She was awarded a [[German Academic Exchange Service]] (DAAD) scholarship to work at [[Leibniz University Hannover]]. She was a postdoctoral fellow at the [[Virginia Polytechnic]] Institute.<ref name=":3" />

== Research and career ==
Bolzani was appointed to the faculty at the [[São Paulo State University]].<ref name=":3" /> In 1998 she established the Centre for Natural Product Bioassays, Biosynthesis and Eco-physiology (NuBBE).<ref name=":0" /> NuBBE is a green laboratory that does not use chlorinated products or toxic solvents.<ref name=":0" /> Her research considers plant science, in particular, the isolation and study of secondary metabolites and peptides in plants.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://bswoc2012.galoa.com.br/node/114.html|title=Prof. Dr. Vanderlan Bolzani {{!}} 3rd Brazil-Spain Workshop on Organic Chemistry|website=bswoc2012.galoa.com.br|access-date=2019-10-07|archive-date=2022-09-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220921212121/http://bswoc2012.galoa.com.br/node/114.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> She has studied the biosynthesis of [[piperidine]] [[alkaloid]]s.<ref name=":3" /> She has studied the [[biodiversity]] of Brazil, and called for new technologies and scientific policy to support preservation of the Brazilian rainforest.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=VALLI|first=MARILIA|last2=RUSSO|first2=HELENA M.|last3=BOLZANI|first3=VANDERLAN S.|date=2018-04-16|title=The potential contribution of the natural products from Brazilian biodiversity to bioeconomy|journal=Anais da Academia Brasileira de Ciências|volume=90|issue=1 suppl 1|pages=763–778|doi=10.1590/0001-3765201820170653|pmid=29668803|issn=1678-2690|doi-access=free|hdl=11449/164172|hdl-access=free}}</ref> She has since studied [[phytochemistry]] and [[endophytic fungi]].

=== Academic service ===
She has served as Deputy Director of the [[São Paulo State University]] Innovation Agency from 2009.<ref name=":0" /> She has campaigned for women scientists throughout her academic career.<ref>{{Cite journal|title=A brief overview on Brazilian women in chemistry|last=Santos|first=Natacha Carvalho Ferreira|last2=Valli|first2=Marilia|date=2019-04-24|journal=Pure and Applied Chemistry|volume=91|issue=4|pages=743–749|language=en|last3=Bolzani|first3=Vanderlan da Silva|doi=10.1515/pac-2018-1002|doi-access=free}}</ref> In 2012 Bolzani joined the advisory board of the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://europe.plantscienceconferences.com/speaker/2017/vanderlan-da-s-bolzani-sao-paulo-state-university-brazil|title=Vanderlan da S. Bolzani {{!}} Plant Science 2017 {{!}} Conferenceseries|website=europe.plantscienceconferences.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref>

=== Awards and honours ===
Her awards and honours include;

* 2008 Elected President of the [[Brazilian Chemical Society]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.chemistryworld.com/news/fears-for-academic-freedom-as-brazils-political-climate-deteriorates/3010315.article|title=Fears for academic freedom as Brazil's political climate deteriorates|last=Moreno |first=Santiago Sáez |date=2019-04-03 |website=Chemistry World|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref>
* 2010 Elected Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]]<ref name=":2" />
* 2011 Elected to the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="www2.unesp.br">{{Cite web|url=https://www2.unesp.br/portal?utm_source&#!/noticia/12224/fisico-da-unesp-e-eleito-fellow-of-the-world-academy-of-sciences/|title=Unesp - Universidade Estadual Paulista - Portal|website=www2.unesp.br|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref>
* 2011 [[Brazilian Chemical Society]] [[:pt:Medalha Simão Mathias|Simão Mathias Medal]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.fapesp.br/en/6498|title=FAPESP :: FAPESP Panels - Vanderlan da Silva Bolzani|website=www.fapesp.br|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref>
* 2011 [[American Chemical Society]] Distinguished Women in Science Chemistry and Chemical Engineering<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chemistryviews.org/details/ezine/1310949/Distinguished_Women_ChemistryChemical_Engineering_Award.html|title=Distinguished Women Chemistry/Chemical Engineering Award :: ChemViews Magazine :: ChemistryViews|website=www.chemistryviews.org|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Santos|first=Natacha Carvalho Ferreira|last2=Valli|first2=Marilia|last3=Bolzani|first3=Vanderlan da Silva|date=2019|title=A brief overview on Brazilian women in chemistry|journal=Pure and Applied Chemistry|volume=91|issue=4|pages=743–749|doi=10.1515/pac-2018-1002|issn=1365-3075|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://iupac.org/100/stories/iupac-distinguished-women-in-chemistry/|title=IUPAC Distinguished Women in Chemistry|website=IUPAC 100|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref>
* 2013 Elected to [[The World Academy of Sciences|The World Academy of Science]]<ref name="www2.unesp.br"/>
* 2014 Capes-[[Elsevier]] Award<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elsevier.com/connect/awards-recognize-women-scientists-in-brazil|title=Awards recognize women scientists in Brazil|last=Elsevier|website=Elsevier Connect|language=en|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref> 
* 2015 Vice President of the [[Sociedade Brasileira para o Progresso da Ciência]]<ref name=":4">{{Cite web|url=http://portal.sbpcnet.org.br/noticias/sbq-lanca-premio-vanderlan-da-silva-bolzani/|title=SBQ lança Prêmio "Vanderlan da Silva Bolzani" – SBPC|language=pt-BR|access-date=2019-10-07}}</ref>
* 2015 [[Brazilian Chemical Society]] Kurt Politzer Technological Innovation Award<ref name=":4" />
* 2018 Superior Council of [[Fundacao de Amparo a Pesquisa do Estado de Sao Paulo]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://cibfar.ifsc.usp.br/english/2018/03/01/vanderlan-bolzani-appointed-to-the-fapesp-conselho-superior/|title=Vanderlan Bolzani appointed to the Fapesp Conselho Superior|website=CIBFar|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-07|archive-date=2019-10-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191007202112/http://cibfar.ifsc.usp.br/english/2018/03/01/vanderlan-bolzani-appointed-to-the-fapesp-conselho-superior/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2019 it was announced that the [[Brazilian Chemical Society]] would create a ''Vanderlan da Silva Bolzani Prize'' for women scientists.<ref name=":1" />

== Personal life ==
Bolzani was married to the sociologist Jorge Bolzani, who she met during graduate school in 1977. Together they had two children. Jorge Bolzani died in 2011.<ref name=":0" />
